db:select.doc:name: Query Existing Event by Key
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, event_key, shipment_id, tracking_number, carrier, original_status, normalized_status, event_timestamp, received_timestamp, processing_result, correlation_id FROM shipment_tracking_events WHERE event_key = :eventKey LIMIT 1;

db:select.doc:name: Query Shipment by Tracking Number
db:select.db:sql: SELECT shipment_id, tracking_number, carrier, origin_location, destination_location, current_status, status_rank, last_event_timestamp, estimated_delivery_time, promised_delivery_time, risk_level, risk_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM shipments WHERE tracking_number = :trackingNumber LIMIT 1;

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Tracking Event
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java fun toSqlDt(val) = if (val == null or (val as String) == "") null else do { var s = (val as String) replace "T" with " " replace "Z" with "" --- if (sizeOf(s) >= 19) s[0 to 18] else s } --- { eventKey: vars.canonicalEvent.eventKey, eventId: vars.canonicalEvent.eventId, shipmentId: vars.canonicalEvent.shipmentId, trackingNumber: vars.canonicalEvent.trackingNumber, carrier: vars.canonicalEvent.carrier, originalStatus: vars.canonicalEvent.originalStatus, normalizedStatus: vars.canonicalEvent.normalizedStatus, eventTimestamp: toSqlDt(vars.canonicalEvent.eventTimestamp), receivedTimestamp: toSqlDt(vars.canonicalEvent.receivedTimestamp), location: vars.canonicalEvent.location, description: vars.canonicalEvent.description, processingResult: vars.processingResult default "PROCESSED", correlationId: vars.correlationId, sourcePayload: vars.canonicalEvent.sourcePayload }]

logger.doc:name: Log Concurrency Duplicate
logger.message: #['[Concurrency Idempotency] Database unique key constraint caught duplicate event key: ' ++ (vars.canonicalEvent.eventKey default '')]

db:update.doc:name: Update Shipment Master Record
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE shipments SET current_status = :currentStatus, status_rank = :statusRank, last_event_timestamp = :lastEventTimestamp, estimated_delivery_time = COALESCE(:estimatedDeliveryTime, estimated_delivery_time), risk_level = :riskLevel, risk_reason = :riskReason WHERE shipment_id = :shipmentId;
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java fun toSqlDt(val) = if (val == null or (val as String) == "") null else do { var s = (val as String) replace "T" with " " replace "Z" with "" --- if (sizeOf(s) >= 19) s[0 to 18] else s } --- { currentStatus: vars.canonicalEvent.normalizedStatus, statusRank: vars.newStatusRank default 15, lastEventTimestamp: toSqlDt(vars.canonicalEvent.eventTimestamp), estimatedDeliveryTime: toSqlDt(vars.canonicalEvent.estimatedDeliveryTime), riskLevel: vars.riskAssessment.riskLevel default "ON_TRACK", riskReason: vars.riskAssessment.explanation default "Status updated.", shipmentId: vars.targetShipment.shipment_id }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Pending Tracking Event
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO pending_tracking_events ( event_key, tracking_number, carrier, payload, received_timestamp, retry_count, processing_status, last_error, correlation_id ) VALUES ( :eventKey, :trackingNumber, :carrier, :payload, :receivedTimestamp, 0, 'PENDING', :lastError, :correlationId ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = :lastError, correlation_id = :correlationId;
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java fun toSqlDt(val) = if (val == null or (val as String) == "") null else do { var s = (val as String) replace "T" with " " replace "Z" with "" --- if (sizeOf(s) >= 19) s[0 to 18] else s } --- { eventKey: vars.canonicalEvent.eventKey, trackingNumber: vars.canonicalEvent.trackingNumber, carrier: vars.canonicalEvent.carrier, payload: vars.canonicalEvent.sourcePayload, receivedTimestamp: toSqlDt(vars.canonicalEvent.receivedTimestamp), lastError: "Shipment record not yet created in tracking master table.", correlationId: vars.correlationId }]

db:select.doc:name: Query Shipment by ID or Tracking
db:select.db:sql: SELECT shipment_id, tracking_number, carrier, origin_location, destination_location, current_status, status_rank, last_event_timestamp, estimated_delivery_time, promised_delivery_time, risk_level, risk_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM shipments WHERE shipment_id = :identifier OR tracking_number = :identifier LIMIT 1;

db:select.doc:name: Query Chronological Events
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, event_key, shipment_id, tracking_number, carrier, original_status, normalized_status, event_timestamp, received_timestamp, location, description, processing_result, correlation_id FROM shipment_tracking_events WHERE tracking_number = :identifier OR shipment_id = :identifier ORDER BY event_timestamp ASC, id ASC;

db:select.doc:name: Query Outbox Notifications
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, notification_id, shipment_id, tracking_number, carrier, milestone, message_body, channels, status, retry_count, correlation_id, created_at, sent_at FROM notification_outbox WHERE tracking_number = :identifier OR shipment_id = :identifier ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC;

db:select.doc:name: Query Carrier Operational Metrics
db:select.db:sql: SELECT c.carrier, COALESCE(e.total_events, 0) AS total_events_received, COALESCE(e.processed_events, 0) AS successfully_processed, COALESCE(e.duplicate_events, 0) AS duplicate_events, COALESCE(e.out_of_order_events, 0) AS out_of_order_events, COALESCE(e.unknown_status_events, 0) AS unknown_status_events, COALESCE(p.pending_events, 0) AS pending_unknown_shipments, COALESCE(s.active_shipments, 0) AS active_shipment_count, e.latest_event_received_at FROM ( SELECT 'BLUEDART' AS carrier UNION ALL SELECT 'DELHIVERY' AS carrier ) c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN processing_result IN ('PROCESSED', 'REPLAYED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processed_events, SUM(CASE WHEN processing_result = 'DUPLICATE_SUPPRESSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duplicate_events, SUM(CASE WHEN processing_result = 'OUT_OF_ORDER_RECORDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_order_events, SUM(CASE WHEN normalized_status = 'UNKNOWN_STATUS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_status_events, MAX(event_timestamp) AS latest_event_received_at FROM shipment_tracking_events GROUP BY carrier ) e ON c.carrier = e.carrier LEFT JOIN ( SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS pending_events FROM pending_tracking_events WHERE processing_status = 'PENDING' GROUP BY carrier ) p ON c.carrier = p.carrier LEFT JOIN ( SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS active_shipments FROM shipments WHERE current_status NOT IN ('DELIVERED', 'RETURNED') GROUP BY carrier ) s ON c.carrier = s.carrier;

db:select.doc:name: Find Reconcilable Pending Events
db:select.db:sql: SELECT p.id, p.event_key, p.tracking_number, p.carrier, p.payload, p.correlation_id, s.shipment_id FROM pending_tracking_events p INNER JOIN shipments s ON p.tracking_number = s.tracking_number WHERE p.processing_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY p.received_timestamp ASC;

db:update.doc:name: Mark Pending Event Reconciled
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE pending_tracking_events SET processing_status = 'RECONCILED', last_error = NULL WHERE id = :id;

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Notification Outbox
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { notificationId: vars.notificationPayload.notificationId, shipmentId: vars.notificationPayload.shipmentId, trackingNumber: vars.notificationPayload.trackingNumber, carrier: vars.notificationPayload.carrier, milestone: vars.notificationPayload.milestone, messageBody: vars.notificationPayload.messageBody, channels: (vars.notificationPayload.channels joinBy ",") default "SMS,EMAIL", correlationId: vars.correlationId }]

db:update.doc:name: Update Outbox Sent Status
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE notification_outbox SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = NOW(3) WHERE notification_id = :notificationId;

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Integration Alert
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { alertId: "ALT-" ++ ((uuid() as String)[0 to 7]), alertType: vars.alertType default "SYSTEM_WARNING", severity: vars.alertSeverity default "WARNING", trackingNumber: vars.alertTrackingNumber, carrier: vars.alertCarrier, alertMessage: vars.alertMessage default "Operational anomaly detected.", correlationId: vars.correlationId }]
